verdict: Ads reached real searchers this period, but conversion tracking is broken.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, $675.14 in Google Ads spend delivered 138 clicks to your site — and recorded zero leads. The data confirms this is a tracking and call-routing failure, not an ad performance failure: your Google Business Profile alone drove 49 direction requests this period, showing genuine local interest. The top campaign ("BWS - Search Campaign - Calls") accounted for $395.15 of that spend, and calls are registering at zero despite active call-targeting, pointing to a misconfiguration in how calls are captured and attributed. Conversion tracking repair and a full end-to-end stack re-test are underway now, and once attribution is restored you should expect the lead count to reflect what the click volume already suggests is happening.
